trails.title: From probability to Active Inference
trails.summary: Start with a small update rule, then distinguish that teaching example from broader accounts of cognition and Bayesian mechanics.
trails.prerequisites: Basic fractions; familiarity with conditional probability helps with the final paper.

steps.goal: Change a prior and likelihoods. Explain why an observation changes the posterior and identify impossible evidence.

steps.goal: Read the interview for conceptual context. Separate discussion of the Free Energy Principle from experimental evidence.

steps.goal: Sample the Fundamentals onboarding discussion and note unfamiliar terms to revisit in the monograph.

steps.goal: Inspect the worked example's assumptions and equations; identify the extra structure beyond the binary update.

trails.title: Ants, reinforcement and collective behavior
trails.summary: Compare an abstract reinforcement process with empirical measurements and specific models of ant behavior.
trails.prerequisites: Introductory biology and probability; no programming required for the first three steps.

steps.goal: Repeat a seed, vary reinforcement, and explain which biological mechanisms the urn leaves out.
steps.title: Reinforced urn

steps.goal: Identify the measured variables and distinguish reported associations from causal mechanisms.
steps.title: Gene expression variation in the brains of harvester ant foragers is associated with collective behavior

steps.goal: Compare a specific pheromone model's assumptions and outputs with the abstract urn.
steps.title: A single-pheromone model accounts for empirical patterns of ant colony foraging previously modeled using two pheromones

steps.goal: Sample the Active Inferants discussion and list the modeling choices that need their own empirical validation.
steps.title: ActInf Livestream #029.0 ~ “Active Inferants: An Active Inference Framework for Ant Colony Behavior”

steps.goal: Inspect the repository's data workflow and evidence boundaries before considering a local run.

steps.goal: Identify the framework's units of analysis and its account of conflict and trust.

steps.goal: Compare the role of open standards with the preceding narrative perspective.

steps.goal: Follow the distinctions among properties, processes and perspectives in the proposed framework.
